device_scope: The tested monochrome Scribe, Amazon build 4794320058

pixel_analysis.scope: Initial scale qualification; final performance comparison uses production Triangle outputs.
pixel_analysis.assessment: Correct target geometry and all 256 gray codes; localized differences between the hardware filter and bilinear require explicit quality reporting rather than a bit-exact claim.

quality.threshold: This scene only: MAE <= 1 and PSNR >= 40 dB; different filters are not bit-exact.

jpeg_tolerance.reference: Direct JPEG grayscale decoding through Pillow/libjpeg luminance draft mode; bypass RGB conversion and clipping. RGB-roundtrip differences are retained separately.

chroma_comparison.reference_scope: Approximate chroma reference after RGB decoding and BOX downsampling, not raw libjpeg planar output.
